summary.headline: Reception and Perfection of the Matter
summary.text: Horary astrology discussion of whether a querent will acquire a dead person’s substance, using Venus, the Moon, and Mars to explain prohibition, reception, dignity, angularity, disposition, commission, and perfection of the matter; the example ends when Venus leaves Aquarius for Pisces and the hoped-for result fails.
